Folio | Backend / Product Engineers | REMOTE (US) | Full-time | https://folio.co

Hotel procurement's a $400B industry still running on spreadsheets and phone calls (and faxes!). We're bringing world-class AI search, web automations, and payment infra to this massive space. Folio is a first-of-its-kind marketplace connecting hotels + restaurants with their hundreds of suppliers using our AI-driven concierge-buying, invoice processing, and agentic payments.

Open Roles:

Our 16-person team hails from Plaid, Square, Persona, Slack, and Cruise. We're fully-remote with a hub in San Francisco, NYC, and Durham, and we meet up quarterly at one of our 300+ hotel partners.

- Software Engineer, Product (Full Stack) • Build the marketplace and payments experience that hotel buyers and suppliers love: https://folio.co/jobs/software-engineer-fullstack

- Software Engineer, Backend • Scale our marketplace infrastructure, search, and payment systems: https://folio.co/jobs/software-engineer-backend

Tech Stack: Rails, React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, AWS, Elasticsearch, DBT, Snowflake

We're at your service: https://folio.co/careers
